content:
Maria C: Kestrel reports sales applied an enterprise grant tied to PO KST-2024-07 but invoice still shows full balance. PO note says "sales manual override" — can billing confirm if a ledger entry posted? Attaching their case: https://redwood.support/cases/CS-9876

Dylan R: I submitted the manual grant from sales ops and added the PO note. I thought billing would run the journal entry. @Ashish B can you check the posting?

Ashish B: Looking now. I see a queued journal entry with ref manual_grant_kestrel_1723 but it failed with: "GL account not found (code: GL404)". Need the correct GL/cost center before I can re-post.

Zoe L: Quick repro from CS UI: 1) open customer invoice KST-INV-4422 2) click Adjustments -> nothing listed 3) customer still shows full balance. So the JE never hit ledger.

Dylan R: Cost center used in the sales note was ACC-ENT-REV-05. I thought finance approved this in the contract amendment. Copying approval snippet: "Sales grant approved by Finance via contract addendum" (internal link).

billing-bot: Automated check: no ledger entry found for external_ref=manual_grant_kestrel_1723. Please verify GL before manual posting.

Ashish B: Ok — I'll post once you confirm the GL. To confirm, I'll use this internal endpoint:

```
POST /internal/ledger/post
Body: {
  "ref": "manual_grant_kestrel_1723",
  "gl": "ACC-ENT-REV-05",
  "amount": "12500",
  "currency": "USD",
  "note": "Kestrel enterprise promo - sales override per PO KST-2024-07"
}
```

Dylan R: Confirmed — ACC-ENT-REV-05 is the approved cost center. I also added the contract PO note in Salesforce (SF-5489).

Ashish B: Posting JE now. Running the post and then triggering billing reconcile job.

Maria C: ETA to show on the customer's invoice? Need to update Kestrel before EOD.

Ashish B: JE POST returned status=SUCCESS, journal_id=jrn_2024_9876. Triggering hourly billing reconcile job (manual).

billing-bot: Billing reconcile job triggered by Ashish B: run_id=2024-10-12_17:10_run_73. Result: invoice KST-INV-4422 adjusted, credit applied $12,500 USD, new balance $0 USD.

Maria C: Confirmed with Kestrel — they now see zero balance. Closing support case. Thanks everyone. :tada:

Dylan R: I'll update the sales process doc to require GL in the PO note for manual grants to avoid repeats.

Zoe L: Suggestion for CS: quick KB -> "How to escalate when sales issues manual grant" with checklist (include GL, approval link, and external_ref). I'll draft a short one.

Ashish B: Agree. Also tagging FIN to remind approvers to include GL in contract addenda.
